page.layout: One page: the digitiser's cover sheet of e-rara.ch, with the logo at top right, the site address, a title block, a centred paragraph of usage notes in four languages, and the Visual Library logo at bottom right. No printed page of the book.
page.notes: This scan is a digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. Per the rules, the logo, banner, site links, terms-of-use text and the bibliographic block are left out. Petri Martyris Vermilii divinarum literarum professoris in schola Tigurina, habita ibidem", author Simmler, Josias, place and year Tiguri, anno 1563, Zentralbibliothek Zürich, shelf mark 5.224,2, persistent link https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-3210.
